baseline: Fresh release of current WIP before this task; retains previously committed spatial light grid. Historical 21.82% is not this paired baseline.

metal.scope: GPU times are frame-weighted averages of Metal per-window frame counters; FPS is the native layer presentation counter. Window means are not individual-frame percentiles; GPU time is not whole-device utilization. Memory is actual MTLDevice allocation in the provided sample, overlapping process unified memory; a short memory sample cannot establish a 60s peak.
